DIAGNOSIS READY: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood

The onset of symptoms coinciding specifically with the transition to high school, combined with the absence of chronic childhood attention deficits and primary mood symptoms like sleep disturbance or weight change, strongly suggests an adjustment disorder rather than ADHD or a major depressive disorder.
